brain.commentary: Cross-asset conditions are risk-on, but the investable edge is marginal: most long signals have composites near zero and only modest conviction. BTC is the strongest and most liquid signal, while ETH and SOL carry elevated volatility and negative alpha. LTC is explicitly flat with weak alpha, liquidity, and institutional support. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile because their identical metrics, zero volatility, and zero expected shortfall suggest stale or incomplete risk data; do not treat their apparent long signals as robust.
